title: [correctness] Windows case-sensitivity false-positive in safeResolveWorkspaceRoot containment
description: safeResolveWorkspaceRoot (input-validation.ts:91) uses path.normalize + string startsWith for containment. path.normalize does NOT change case. On Windows (case-insensitive NTFS — the dev platform), if NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE case differs from process.cwd() case, the check throws a false-positive 'path traversal'. The code comment at line 90 FALSELY claims case-insensitive comparison is performed. 12 endpoint/service callers throw → endpoints return 500.
fix_direction: Use platform-agnostic containment: path.relative(root, resolved) and reject if result starts with '..' or isAbsolute. OR lowercase both sides on Windows (process.platform === 'win32'). Fix the misleading comment either way. Add a Windows case-mismatch test (forward-slash + backslash forms).

context.location: src-ts/mcp/input-validation.ts:73-99 (safeResolveWorkspaceRoot), comment at line 90, comparison lines 91-98
context.suggested_fix: Replace `if (normalizedResolved !== normalizedRoot && !normalizedResolved.startsWith(normalizedRoot + path.sep))` with `const rel = path.relative(normalizedRoot, normalizedResolved); if (rel.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(rel)) throw ...;`. path.relative returns '' for equal paths and '..\x' for outside (case-insensitive on Windows).
context.notes: Deep-dive verified (confidence 0.95). Core module correctness bug on the dev platform. See review.json deep_dives.CORR-001_verification.

resolution: Fixed in input-validation.ts: safeResolveWorkspaceRoot now compares case-insensitively on Windows (process.platform === 'win32' -> toLowerCase both sides). Removed redundant path.normalize + corrected the misleading comment. Added 1 Windows case-mismatch test (skipped on POSIX). Full suite 5895 pass / 7 pre-existing (0 new).

title: [security] resolveWorkspaceRootForRequest trusts caller-supplied workspaceRoot without containment (defense-in-depth gap)
description: resolveWorkspaceRootForRequest (services/workflow.ts:206 + workflow-revision.ts:38) returns workspace.identity.workspaceRoot verbatim when existsSync passes, bypassing safeResolveWorkspaceRoot. Deep-dive confirmed NO live bypass: all endpoint callers sanitize via resolveWorkspace(body) (endpoints/workflow.ts:47) which OVERRIDES identity.workspaceRoot with the safe root before passing to the service. But the service contract is unsafe — it trusts input.
fix_direction: Apply containment inside resolveWorkspaceRootForRequest: resolve the requested path and verify it is within safeResolveWorkspaceRoot() before returning; else fall back to safe root. Defense-in-depth at the service boundary.

context.suggested_fix: Inside resolveWorkspaceRootForRequest, wrap the requested path: `const safe = safeResolveWorkspaceRoot(); const resolved = path.resolve(requestedWorkspaceRoot); const rel = path.relative(safe, resolved); if (rel.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(rel)) return safe; return resolved;`.
context.notes: Downgraded from HIGH via deep-dive (confidence 0.92): endpoint sanitizer resolveWorkspace(body) overwrites user value, so no live bypass. Latent risk: future caller passing raw request workspace. See review.json deep_dives.SEC-001_reassessment.

title: [security] path traversal throw propagates as 500 with internal path leak
description: safeResolveWorkspaceRoot throws 'Workspace path traversal detected: "<resolved>" is outside allowed root "<root>"'. Callers (chat/critic/workspace/graph/memory/wiki/workflow/agent — 8 endpoints) call it without a local try/catch; the throw propagates to the outer handler catch → 500 with the error message in the body. (1) Security rejection mis-classified as 500 (should be 400/403). (2) Internal absolute paths (resolved + root) echoed to the caller — information disclosure of host filesystem layout.
fix_direction: Wrap callers in a helper (e.g. withWorkspaceRoot(handler) that calls safeResolveWorkspaceRoot and catches the traversal Error → returns 400/403 with generic 'Invalid workspace configuration', logging the detail server-side only).

context.location: src-ts/mcp/input-validation.ts:73-99 (throw) + 8 endpoint files calling safeResolveWorkspaceRoot without try/catch
context.suggested_fix: Add a withContainedWorkspace(handler) wrapper in mcp/input-validation.ts that try/catches the traversal Error and returns a 400/403 generic response. Apply to the 8 endpoints, OR centralize in the gateway request handler.
context.notes: Pairs with ISS-005 (resolveWorkspaceRootForRequest) — both are workspace containment hardening.

resolution: Fixed: added tryResolveWorkspaceRoot() Result-pattern function + guards in all 12 endpoint/service call sites. Returns 400 with generic message instead of 500 + path leak.
